name: Littoral-Cairn
description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near an orbital debris ring that no expedition has ever claimed.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
